title: Cluster-robust inference: A guide to empirical practice
description: Practical guidance on when cluster-robust inference is needed and how to approach common design and implementation choices.

title: Testing for the Appropriate Level of Clustering in Linear Regression Models
description: An overview of score-variance tests and the statistical trade-offs involved in choosing a clustering level.

title: Jackknife Inference with Two-Way Clustering
description: Jackknife methods designed to improve inference in linear regression models with clustering in two dimensions.

title: Good Guys With Guns?
description: A research overview of Canadian administrative data on legal firearm ownership, deaths, and crime.

title: Wild Bootstrap Inference for Wildly Different Cluster Sizes
description: Why conventional cluster-robust inference can fail with highly unequal cluster sizes and how wild-bootstrap methods can help.

title: Randomization Inference for Difference-in-Differences with Few Treated Clusters
description: Randomization-inference procedures for difference-in-differences designs with few treated clusters.

title: Improved Inference for CSDID Using the Cluster Jackknife
description: How the cluster jackknife can provide more reliable inference for the Callaway-Sant'Anna difference-in-differences estimator.

title: Reworking Wild Bootstrap-Based Inference for Clustered Errors
description: A concise account of refinements to wild-cluster-bootstrap inference for settings with few clusters.

title: Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference for Few Treated Clusters
description: An introduction to wild-bootstrap randomization inference for clustered designs with a small treated group count.

title: Impact of a Peer Comparison Intervention on Seasonal Influenza Vaccine Uptake in Community Pharmacy
description: A short overview of a national cluster-randomized study of peer comparison and influenza vaccination in community pharmacies.

title: A Simple, Graphical Procedure for Comparing Multiple Treatment Effects
description: A graphical method for comparing multiple treatment effects against a control and against one another.

title: Immigrant Parents' Category of Admission and Outcomes of the Children: How Far Does the Apple Fall?
description: How immigrant admission categories in Canada relate to the long-run outcomes of children.

title: Targeting Tax Relief at Youth Employment
description: Evidence on the employment effects of Canada's Youth Hires payroll-tax-relief program.

title: Finish It and It's Free: An Evaluation of College Graduation Subsidies
description: An evaluation of Canadian graduate tax credits, university completion, and interprovincial mobility.

title: Choosing Portfolios of Rival Risky Options: Most People Violate the No Safety Schools Theorem
description: Experimental evidence on how people choose portfolios when options are risky and rival.
